question: Where should one see consciousness residing in the body?
premises: all elements dissolve and burn there
that consciousness resides in the body
inference: one should see that consciousness where all elements dissolve
uncertainties: whether kāyasthāṃ modifies citiṃ or tāṃ
plain_english: Where all elements dissolve and burn, see that consciousness residing in the body, equal in splendor to the fire of time.
